difficulty_reason: Characterisation of quasi-coherent sheaves on X in terms of restrictions to the slice sites: the forward direction notes sheafiness for fppf and pullback stability, the converse computes X/y = (Sch/V)_fppf, applies Descent, equivalence-quasi-coherent to produce F_V, and checks that every x^* F|_{U_etale} is the pullback of F_V before invoking lemma-characterize-quasi-coherent. Complete two-sided argument. Retained author proof at lines 1925-1956.
